baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperative فَأَسْرِ, the collective بِعِبَادِى, the night adverb لَيْلًا, and the passive مُّتَّبَعُونَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: A command-responsive collective receives a night head start while an expected trailing force closes distance. Night supplies concealment and timing, but the passive pursuit makes the movement relational rather than a private departure.

activation_trace.role: Night travel supplies the commanded mode of movement and places the group ahead of its pursuers.
Submissive service supplies a collective disposed to move under command rather than an accidental crowd.
Night as darkness provides the temporal cover in which the head start is created.
Following after supplies the rearward relation between the moving collective and another force.
Catching up turns generic following into a chase whose distance can narrow.

changed_reading.before: Take the servants away at night because others will follow.
changed_reading.after: Create a timed head start for a command-bound collective inside an already anticipated chase geometry.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The split mapping available for فَأَسْرِ, reinforced by لَيْلًا and qualified by مُّتَّبَعُونَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The non-dominant concealment branch and night darkness hide the travelers, while stepwise tracking implies that their route remains recoverable. The focus can therefore hold secrecy and legibility together rather than equating night with disappearance.

activation_trace.role: The split-root image of inward concealment supplies a form-distant secrecy layer to the night journey.
Night darkness makes concealment materially plausible.
Stepwise tracking preserves a readable sequence of traces despite the cover of night.

changed_reading.before: Night is chosen simply so the group will not be seen.
changed_reading.after: The group is concealed without becoming untrackable; the text stages selective secrecy inside a traceable route.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The owned-status branch of عِبَادِى beside the claim and liability branches of مُّتَّبَعُونَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: When socially dependent persons depart, pursuit can function as attempted repossession, not only physical following. The attached-liability branch also leaves open a second direction: the chase may carry a consequence that adheres to participants.

activation_trace.role: Night travel supplies the actual removal of the dependent group from its prior place.
Owned or enslaved status makes the departing people possible objects of a possessive claim.
Pursuing a right recasts the chase as a claimant's effort to recover what it treats as due.
An incurred consequence that attaches to someone keeps a live alternative in which pursuit carries liability with it.

changed_reading.before: An enemy will chase the departing group.
changed_reading.after: A possessive claimant will try to recover departing dependents, while the pursuit itself may bear an attached consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier sequence joins night with differentiation, binding command, and sending. Repetition of night in the focus turns the march into an enacted dispatch that sorts linked populations into different trajectories, not merely a tactically convenient escape.

activation_trace.role: Night travel is the concrete motion through which the dispatch is enacted.
Doing something by night makes night an operational setting rather than a backdrop.
Following keeps the two populations linked even while the command begins to separate them.
The earlier night-oriented action establishes a repeated temporal mode for consequential operations.
Differentiating one thing from another supplies the sorting function assigned to the later departure.
Binding command supplies authorization and necessity rather than spontaneous flight.
Sending and setting in motion supplies the dispatch pattern realized by the imperative to travel.

structural_cues: 44:3-5 sequences night, differentiation, command, and sending before 44:23 repeats night movement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated night and the ordered branch sequence; I infer that the later march materially enacts that sequence. A live alternative is thematic resonance without a direct operational correspondence.

changed_reading.before: Night is tactical cover for an escape.
changed_reading.after: Night is a commissioning interval in which a command dispatches people and begins an ordered separation while their pursuers remain attached.

context_deltas.mechanism: Before the focus, lifting affliction is brief and followed by return; after it, rescue is named as release by separation. The uncovering-and-relief branch of فَأَسْرِ lets the physical night journey become the mechanism that converts reversible respite into durable removal.

activation_trace.role: Uncovering and the clearing of distress supplies a latent relief-result inside the travel command.
Actual night travel supplies the spatial action by which relief can cease to be temporary.
Removing a cover supplies the earlier image of affliction being lifted only briefly.
Return after turning away supplies the failure mode of temporary relief.
Deliverance by separation supplies the later durable outcome of the commanded movement.

structural_cues: 44:12 requests removal of affliction, 44:15 makes that removal slight and followed by return, and 44:30 names rescue after the focus journey.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies temporary uncovering, return, travel, and later separating rescue; I infer that travel is the causal arrow from respite to durable release. Alternatively, the two relief sequences may be parallel rather than causally contrasted.

changed_reading.before: The command initiates a physical escape.
changed_reading.after: The journey is the operation that turns a briefly lifted burden into relief secured by irreversible separation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The demand to render God's servants, the prohibition on domination, and the retrospective rescue from humiliation sharpen the focus possessive into restored custody. On this reading, the pursuers enact a defeated counterclaim by a regime that had treated persons as owned and usable.

activation_trace.role: Owned status exposes the contested social claim carried by the word for servants.
Devotional service supplies the competing affiliation encoded by the possessive 'My servants.'
Pursuit of a right makes the chase a counterclaim by the former holder.
Attached liability allows the counterclaim to carry its own adverse consequence.
Rendering a right or trust frames the demand for the servants as restitution rather than a request for access.
The repeated owned-status branch makes social possession explicit immediately before the focus.
Dominating mastery identifies the coercive power whose custody claim is being rejected.
Release by separation confirms that the transfer of custody results in actual deliverance.
Humiliation through contempt specifies the degraded condition from which the servants are removed.

structural_cues: 44:18 demands delivery of God's servants, 44:19 rejects domination, and 44:30-31 retrospectively names rescue from humiliating punishment under an overreaching ruler.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies delivery-as-duty, competing servant statuses, domination, pursuit-as-claim, and later rescue; I infer a custody reversal. The live alternative is that 'servants of God' is purely devotional and the pursuit only military.

changed_reading.before: A ruler chases people who escaped his control.
changed_reading.after: The night departure restores persons from coerced ownership to divine service, and the chase is the old regime's legally colored but doomed counterclaim.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate order to leave the sea in an open state and the declaration that the following host will drown make pursuit operationally necessary. A residual trace and open gap conduct the army into the same corridor, so the night movement manages visibility and spacing instead of maximizing disappearance.

activation_trace.role: Night travel creates the lead segment of the controlled route.
Stepwise tracking makes the departing group's route a sequence the pursuers can read.
Catching up supplies the pursuers' entry into the same narrowing corridor.
Leaving an effect behind activates the deliberate preservation of a readable route.
A wide cleft gives the sea a corridor-like spatial form.
A broad open gap supplies the maintained passage into which the trackers can follow.
A mutually supporting host supplies the organized trailing body rather than isolated followers.
Killing by submersion supplies the designed terminal result of the preserved corridor.

structural_cues: 44:24 immediately follows the prediction of pursuit with an order about the sea's state and a declaration about the army's drowning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies tracking, a retained trace, an open sea-gap, an organized army, and drowning; I infer that the route is left legible so pursuit enters it. A live alternative is that the sea instruction begins only after escape and does not make the chase bait-like.

changed_reading.before: Travel by night to evade a pursuing army.
changed_reading.after: Take a controlled lead while preserving enough route for the pursuing army to enter the prepared sea corridor.

context_deltas.mechanism: The people treated as owned leave first; soon the would-be owners themselves become leavers whose estate passes to others without contract. The sequence reverses the direction of possession without requiring the escaped servants to be the named heirs.

activation_trace.role: Owned status supplies the initial attempt to treat persons as property.
Claim-pursuit supplies the effort to restore that possession.
What a dead person leaves behind recasts the pursuers as the dispossessed source of an estate.
Transfer of ownership without contract or effort supplies the reversal's material completion.

structural_cues: 44:25-28 lists what the former possessors leave and says it is passed to another people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies person-as-property, attempted recovery, abandoned estate, and transfer to others; I infer a deliberate inversion of possession. It does not supply the escaped group as beneficiary, so the model leaves the heirs unspecified.

changed_reading.before: The focus concerns only the recovery of escaped laborers.
changed_reading.after: The failed recovery begins a wider reversal in which those claiming persons as property lose their own property to unnamed others.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus arranges bodies linearly as servants moving ahead and pursuers behind. The later protected, secure station and mutual facing reverse that geometry into settled reciprocity, suggesting that escape changes social arrangement as well as location.

activation_trace.role: Owned status supplies the vertical social relation from which the collective moves.
Following after supplies a linear arrangement with one body behind another.
Placing oneself within protection supplies the end of exposed flight.
Residence in a place converts nocturnal motion into stable settlement.
Settled security removes the threat encoded by being pursued.
Thing facing thing reverses the chase line into reciprocal orientation.

structural_cues: 44:51 locates the protected in a secure station, and 44:53 depicts them mutually facing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a chase line and a later secure face-to-face arrangement; I infer a social-spatial reversal from hierarchy to reciprocity. The alternative is a purely scenic endpoint with no comment on social order.

changed_reading.before: The servants need only reach safety ahead of those behind them.
changed_reading.after: Their linear flight out of ownership opens toward a protected settlement whose face-to-face geometry replaces both hierarchy and chase.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines the non-dominant concealment mapping of فَأَسْرِ with its dominant uncovering branch and a context where manifest smoke covers people before covering is lifted. It remains anchored in the focus's night travel and trackable pursuit; downstream prose should call it a selective-visibility model, not an etymological equation of أَسْرِ with secrecy.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: فَأَسْرِ and لَيْلًا supply cover, while مُّتَّبَعُونَ requires enough exposure for a route to be followed.

activation_trace.role: Inward concealment supplies the hidden side of the operation through the packet's split mapping.
Uncovering and relief supplies the opposed possibility that some part of the operation is exposed.
Night darkness supplies controllable cover for the travelers.
Trace-by-trace tracking requires a legible remainder inside that cover.
Manifest appearance makes the obscuring smoke paradoxically visible and diagnostic.
Smoke-like dark opacity supplies cover that can itself be perceptible.
A covering laid over something supplies the concealment phase.
Removing the cover supplies the controlled reversal from hidden to exposed.
The later broad open gap gives selective exposure a concrete route: concealed people can leave an uncovered corridor.

changed_reading.before: Night hides the entire escape operation.
changed_reading.after: Visibility is asymmetric: the travelers can be covered while their residual track and the corridor needed by pursuers remain exposed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading treats people as a routed flow, which is materially analogical rather than literal. It remains worth carrying because the focus inventory itself supplies running or creeping flow, while the context supplies sea, gentle successive movement, drowning, springs, and a water-running divide; downstream prose should mark it as a hydraulic model of route mechanics only.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The running-flow branch of فَأَسْرِ and the successive-motion branch of مُّتَّبَعُونَ.

activation_trace.role: A running stream or creeping extension supplies the material analogy of a collective entering a channel.
Unbroken succession supplies particles or bodies moving one after another through that channel.
Abundant wide water supplies the medium through which the route is cut.
Gentle successive travel supplies controlled flow through the opened sea-space.
Submersion in water supplies the destructive fate of the trailing flow.
A source of running water places flowing water among what the pursuers leave behind.
A divide in mountain or sand through which water runs supplies an unexpectedly exact channel image.
Running springs at the secure end preserve water as an endpoint of life rather than only an instrument of drowning.

changed_reading.before: A group walks through terrain while another group follows.
changed_reading.after: A collective is routed like a controlled current through a temporary channel, with sequence carrying the trailing host into submersion and living water reappearing beyond the crossing.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because it activates the focus root's Tubba-dynasty branch from the later surface قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ, whose proper name has no separate context-root cue. It remains anchored by the packet's explicit focus branch plus branch-backed context citations for peoplehood and destruction; downstream prose should present a political echo, not derive مُّتَّبَعُونَ from the proper name.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مُّتَّبَعُونَ carries both ordinary following and, in its supplied inventory, Tubba as a title of successive rulers; عِبَادِى supplies an alternative command-bound collective.

activation_trace.role: Tubba and successive rulers supply the political-dynastic edge activated by the later proper-name surface.
Succession in order supplies the mechanism by which following can constitute continuity of rule or community.
Submissive service supplies a non-dynastic basis for collective coordination under command.
A people or collective supplies the social body named beside Tubba.
Falling into destruction supplies the failure of the dynastic collective used as contrast.

changed_reading.before: The passive participle only predicts military pursuit.
changed_reading.after: As a contained political echo, the pursued servants may be forming a command-based counter-collective against a later image of dynastic succession that ends in destruction.

strongest_changes: Night becomes an interval of commissioned sorting and dispatch, not only concealment.
The servants' movement becomes a custody reversal, while pursuit becomes a possessive counterclaim carrying liability.
The prediction of pursuit becomes operational: a readable trace and open sea corridor conduct the army toward drowning.
The chase's linear hierarchy can terminate in protected residence and reciprocal face-to-face social geometry.
summary.what_was_special: The focus compresses opposed functions into one short command: concealment with traceability, flight that requires pursuit, servants who are both socially claimed and devotionally reassigned, and forward movement that later reverses possession and spatial hierarchy. The sea context makes 'you will be followed' part of the rescue mechanism rather than merely its danger.
remaining_uncertainties: The secrecy model depends on a non-dominant split mapping and should remain exploratory.
The custody reading infers a legal-social force from delivery, owned status, and claim branches; a purely devotional and military reading remains live.
The inheritance sequence does not identify the escaped servants as heirs, so only the reversal of possession is retained.
The hydraulic and Tubba models are deliberately contained analogies, not lexical identifications.
